about_the_game:
🕵️‍♂️ Exit Strategy: Demo

Welcome to the 9-to-5 stealth challenge you didn’t know you needed.

In this playable demo of Exit Strategy, sneak your way out of the office without getting caught by the boss or flagged by HR. Use stealth, mischief, and makeshift distractions to escape the grind — all while navigating a hilariously mundane workplace.

🗂️ What’s in the Demo:

  • Core stealth gameplay with walking, running, crouching, crawling, and wall-hugging

  • Throw and interact with items like cups, mice, keyboards, and food

  • Environmental traps including:

    • Microwave stink cloud

    • Coffee machine overflow

    • Copier paper blast

    • Slippery water spill

  • Hide under desks, inside lockers, or inside boxes to avoid detection

  • AI coworkers roam, HR patrols and alerts the boss, and the boss himself investigates, guards exits, and gives chase if you’re spotted

  • Escape via the elevator to win — or try to grab your paycheck first for bonus points

  • Sandbox-style level editor with full Steam Workshop support to build and share your own office escape maps

Thanks for playing!

short_description: Sneak, sabotage, escape. In Exit Strategy, the office is your playground—and your prison. Use stealth and chaos to outsmart HR and dodge your boss in this sandbox-style workplace escape game. Play the free demo and try not to get caught.
